criterion: Display simulated versus observed fill labels and their inputs; prevent modeled quote fills from being mistaken for exchange fills.
test_result: 30 execution-adapter and cockpit tests passed; Ruff and targeted mypy passed. Simulated quote inputs are attached to receipts, unverified observed labels remain explicit, and no-fill receipts invent no fills.
evidence_scope: Synthetic quote-replay receipts and observed-label validation fixtures.
operational_limits: The simulator does not create observed exchange or broker fills.
Observed labels require caller-provided source and reconciliation evidence; the view does not authenticate the source.
Raw quote availability depends on upstream archival references and entitlements.
